convention.matrix: 4x4 column-major (three, glTF): elements 12, 13, 14 are the translation; Godot: basis = columns 0..2, origin = column 3
convention.instances: world.glb: EXT_mesh_gpu_instancing TRANSLATION (the matrix translation, float32 bit for bit), ROTATION (unit quaternion x, y, z, w), SCALE, and _COLOR, _AN, _AC2, _AP0, _AP1 (the per-instance extras); the JSON form: matrices, 16 floats an instance
convention.winding: front faces counter-clockwise seen from outside (three, glTF); Godot's are clockwise: a reader of the JSON form reverses each triangle (a glTF importer already does)
convention.uv: as three holds them; a texture samples at uv * repeat + offset, and flipY true puts the image's top row at v = 1 (Godot samples 1 - v), false at v = 0

colours.materials: linear (three's working values written as hex: do not convert)

convention.typed: {type, n, b64}: the array's bytes, little-endian, base64; Float32Array, Uint16Array, Uint32Array
convention.ids: core/tags: a record id is <prefix>_<5 digits> (or the build's own); an instance of an item set is <set id>#<index>; a uid is KTAGS.uid(class, key, at): KRAND.hash(0, fnv1a(class), fnv1a(key), floor(x*10+.5), floor(y*10+.5), floor(z*10+.5)) as 8 hex digits
convention.box: [x0, z0, x1, z1]: an instance belongs to a tile when x0 <= x < x1 and z0 <= z < z1 (its origin); a bucket piece by its foot (the xz of its lowest vertex)

materials.name: ground
materials.note: the valley floor (75-terrain.js): detail over the vertex colours and the painted city ground

registry.convention: metres, +Y up, x east, z south; at is the base centre; ry radians about +Y (the front, +z, turns to (sin ry, cos ry)); size [w, d, h] in the record's own frame; uid: core/tags/README.md

cropped.rule: the records an item or bucket of the tile names, the records whose at lies in the box (not item sets), and their parents

fixtures.note: Yuni's doors, windows and lights (51-fixtures.js): the registry's fixture records with their host, children of their buildings (parent; a street light's is null); local +z is out (ry its yaw); at is a door's threshold centre on the outer face at its sill, a window's pane base, a light's fitting; host.sill is above the building's base. The same ids and uids as KRATOR_EXPORT.fixtures() and KRATOR_EXPORT.tags()

glb.note: items are nodes item_<k> and buckets bucket_<k>, k their index in this file's lists
